left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Age ≥70 year
  -  Eligible cardiovascular disease (CVD) diagnosis (hospitalization for Acute myocardial infarction (AMI) [OR] / Acute coronary syndrome (ACS), stable Ischemic Heart Disease , revascularization Coronary artery bypass graft surgery  [OR] and Percutaneous Coronary Intervention[CABG, [OR]  PCI], valvular heart disease [specifically, surgical  [OR] or percutaneous intervention for mitral regurgitation  [OR] or aortic stenosis] [OR] , or heart failure (HF))
  -  English speaking
  -  able to provide written informed consent
  -  able to be assessed and undergo study interventions

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Unstable medical condition as indicated by history, physical exam, [OR]  and/or laboratory findings
  -  Presence of non-CVD conditions likely to be fatal within 12 months (e

, metastatic cancer)
  -  Severe cognitive impairment: Short Blessed screening with a score of 13 or greater or cannot consent (as indicated by medical record)
  -  Long-term care resident at admission  [AND] with no plans to return to independent living
  -  anticipates inability to return for required reassessments at 3, 6 and 12 months
  -  long-term care residents at admission  [AND] with no plans to return to independent living
